Examples session-oriented APIs are file writers and readers, functions that manage a communication link, driver APIs for instrumentation, and hardware abstraction layers (HAL).\0D\0A\0D\0AESF uses a single base class to manage multiple instantiations of your session wire. These instances can be obtained from anywhere in your application by name, much like a LabVIEW Queue or Notifier.
